hero.title: JHON DANIEL
hero.subtitle: Software Developer
hero.text: Tell me what you would like to build or improve in your business. Together we can find the most suitable solution.

services.title: Tailored solutions for your business
services.intro: From your online presence to more advanced solutions, I help you turn ideas into practical tools.
services.card1Text: Modern, high-performance websites optimized to turn visitors into customers.
services.card2Text: Custom applications to manage business processes and improve the user experience.
services.card3Text: APIs, business logic, and integrations between complex systems.
services.card4Text: Cloud solutions and integrations that make your business faster and more scalable.
services.benefitsIntro: A website or application is not just a technical project, but a tool that can help your business grow, simplify your work, and present you at your best.
services.card5Title: Does it help you find customers?
services.card5Text: A structured online presence helps people find you, understand your business, and turn visitors into contacts.
services.card6Text: By automating repetitive processes and tasks, you can spend more time on what really matters.
services.card7Title: Does it make you look more professional?
services.card7Text: A polished online presence communicates credibility and shows the value of your business in the right way.
services.card8Text: I create tailored tools that reduce manual work, improve workflows, and make daily management easier.

solutions.title: More than a website. A foundation ready to evolve.
solutions.growthTitle: A journey that grows with you.
solutions.text: For a very simple website, a CMS may be enough. When a project needs integrated processes, custom features, or room to grow, I use technologies such as Angular, Java / Spring Boot, and AWS cloud services to build solid, flexible solutions ready for new needs.
solutions.extra: This way, your project can start today as a professional website and evolve over time with new features: customer areas, bookings, payments, document management, automations, dashboards, and integrations with external services.
solutions.highlight: The goal is to build a solution that grows with your business, without having to start from scratch.

about.title: A developer with a practical approach.
about.p1: I am Jhon Daniel, a Software Developer with around 5 years of experience. Throughout my career, I have worked on projects in different sectors, gaining experience in web and backend application development for companies and startups.
about.p2: I enjoy tackling real problems, working with motivated people, and finding concrete solutions that have a measurable impact on business.

experience.title: Technology serving real-world contexts.
experience.text: Throughout my career, I have contributed to software projects in different sectors, gaining experience developing digital solutions used in complex and structured environments.
